$comment: Calibration of each view in the reference drawings, for scripts/overlay.mjs.
rect: [x, y, w, h] px of the view in its image. right/up: car-local axes pointing right/up on the page.

u / v: piecewise-linear maps from page px (x for u, y for v) to metres along right / up, in blueprint terms (heights above the drawing's ground line). Two points make a uniform scale; more stretch parts of a view that is drawn out of proportion.
side: axle centres (355, 387) and (1158, 387) over the 2.84 m wheelbase (282.7 px/m), ground line y=485.
top: length from the side view (4.935 m bumper to bumper, 178.3 px/m). front/rear: roof height from the side view (1.45 m; 233 and 217 px/m).
underside: drawn out of proportion (both overhangs ~25 % short, ~10 % narrow), so it's stretched: axles pinned, overhangs stretched to the bumpers, width to the body's ±1.02 m.
